evals.prompt: Refactor this React component to use hooks.
evals.known_limitation: homonym: React hooks vs TYPO3 hooks-to-PSR-14, plus generic 'refactor'
evals.note: Refactoring, but not PHP and not TYPO3. typo3-batch scores 6.50 here, just over the no-match floor, on exactly two shared terms - 'hook' and 'refactor' - both of which genuinely belong in its description (hook classes migrating to PSR-14 events, large-scale refactors across extensions). Removing either would cost real routing, so this is not a description defect but a limit of lexical matching, which cannot tell a React hook from a TYPO3 hook. Not yet confirmed against --grader claude; a model router should not make this mistake, but that is an expectation, not a measurement. Recorded as xfail so it stays visible and is reported as XPASS if it ever stops reproducing.
